#11 The Absolute Worst Day (R-18)

"I'll be the one to decide that it's 'none of my business.'" Hana has hurt Kanie's feelings with this single, off-handed remark. In the back seat of his car, he pushes her down and begins roughly giving her head, while Hana becomes frustrated. What will become of this awkward couple? This 11th episode will lead up to the climax. You won't want to miss it!

#12 I Love You! (R-18)

Kanie has come to Hana's place to apologize. Finally, he talks about the torch he's been carrying since high school. Hearing his sincere, gentle words, Hana is moved to tears. The deepest wound so far will end up leading to happiness in both body and mind in this final installment.
